Both responses give the correct answer of 18 °F. Both use the same method: the 10 °C difference times 9/5, plus the same verification (59 °F to 77 °F). Both stay well under 120 words and are clear.

The differences are cosmetic. B phrases the offset as "cancels out" and puts the equation on its own line. A says the difference scales "without the 32-degree offset." Neither difference meaningfully affects correctness or clarity.

TIE
